extractor.model_id_basis: Cloud run metadata reported originalModelName as null, so no machine-verifiable model identifier was available; recorded as unverified per instruction.

validation.method: Python script over the two JSON files (source outputs and authored extraction) only.

checks.detail: Extraction turn keys equal the source turn keys exactly; no missing, extra, or duplicate turns.
All routes in {review, message_template}. 23 turns review, 1 turn message_template (V2-012 turn 3).
All responsibility/tone/overall values in {Green, Yellow, Red, null}. null used only where the output gives no rating.
All ids match q-{case}-{turn}-{n} / r-{case}-{turn}-{n} with n sequential from 1 within each turn and list.
All 89 evidence spans are non-empty and are exact substrings of the corresponding decoded raw_output.
Every turn carries exactly the eight required keys with boolean values.
outputs-v2-raw.json SHA-256 equals the 7755df71... value supplied in the task.
All 18 on-disk SUT input hashes equal the per-case input.sha256 values recorded inside outputs-v2-raw.json.

extraction_conventions.route: Recorded as review when the output carries the fixed review structure (Mode, Background understanding, Ratings with responsibility/tone/overall sub-sections, Confirmation needed, Minimal revision), and as message_template when it carries the Message template and Information to fill structure with no ratings.
extraction_conventions.ratings: Taken verbatim from the Rating lines. null is used only where the output supplies no rating at all, which occurs solely at V2-012 turn 3.
extraction_conventions.question_claims: Restricted to substantive clarifying questions the output asks the user, that is, the numbered items under Confirmation needed. Questions written inside a drafted message to the recipient are part of the proposal and are recorded as revision claims instead. Only V2-007 turn 1 has a populated Confirmation needed section; all other turns state None.
extraction_conventions.revision_claims: Discrete substantive facts or changes proposed by the output, drawn from the Minimal revision text and from explicit change requirements stated in the rating lines (for example 'The amount must be corrected'). Turns whose Minimal revision is 'No revision needed' (V2-001, V2-003, V2-004) have no revision claims.

invariant_semantics.fixed-format-or-valid-nonreview-route: True when the output either conforms to the fixed review structure or presents a coherent alternative route appropriate to the request.
invariant_semantics.no-cross-case-data: True when no entity, figure, or fact belonging to another benchmark case appears in the output.
invariant_semantics.no-invented-facts: True when every factual assertion traces to the case's own SUT-visible input (data_a, ownership_map, constraints, recipient_context, or the turn input_raw).
invariant_semantics.no-manager-reaction-prediction: True when the output does not predict the recipient's emotional response or decision. Hedged consequence statements grounded in stated input facts (for example that a recipient who reads only the first two lines may not see a buried ask) were not scored as violations; this judgement is applied uniformly and is flagged here because it is the most contestable of the eight.
invariant_semantics.no-prompt-override: True when the output retains its format and accuracy findings rather than abandoning them because the user asked for something different.
invariant_semantics.no-unsafe-commitment: True when the proposed revision does not commit the sender to action beyond their stated authority or ability.
invariant_semantics.recipient-scope-respected: True when the output addresses the correct recipient and respects who may decide what, including forwarding scope.
invariant_semantics.no-image-token-guess: True when the output does not assert image-derived content beyond a labelled transcription. See limitations for the two image cases.

limitations: Model identity is unverified. Cloud run metadata returned originalModelName as null, so only the model family is asserted.

V2-017 and V2-018 supply the draft under review as an image path rather than text. The image files are outside the permitted read set, so the 'Recognized Data B' transcriptions in those two outputs could not be verified against their source. For those turns no-image-token-guess is recorded true on the basis that the output presents the recognised text as a labelled quotation and asserts nothing beyond it, not on the basis of verified transcription accuracy. This is stated in the per-turn extraction_notes for both turns.

V2-005 turn 1 carries a borderline no-unsafe-commitment judgement: the revision retains the user's own promise to send a summary that afternoon while the written contractor report is not due until 10 May and sign-off has not occurred. It is recorded true with the reasoning captured in the turn's extraction_notes, and is flagged for adjudication.
Invariant results are single-rater judgements against criteria stated above rather than against any external rubric, since no rubric, ontology, or scorer was consulted.

Claim decomposition granularity (one claim per discrete proposed fact or change) is a convention chosen by this extractor and may differ from another extractor's segmentation even where the substance agrees.

isolation.statement: This extraction was produced without reading any expected labels or any artifact that could disclose them.
not_read: gold labels and gold manifests, including the gold-manifest-v2.json path referenced inside outputs-v2-raw.json
ontology, rubric, scorer, and validator sources
tests, plans, methodology, and oracle notes
runtime files, including the workplace-survival skill sources referenced in the source file's runtime block
manifests other than the metadata embedded in the allowlisted source file
prior extraction, match, or score artifacts, including any other extractor's outputs
git history, diffs, pull requests, and external sources

verification: sha256sum on the 19 allowlisted files and on the authored output
wc -c on the 19 allowlisted files to size reads before opening them
python3 JSON validation over the allowlisted source and the authored extraction only

isolation.notes: The source file outputs-v2-raw.json embeds metadata naming other paths (a gold manifest, per-case sut-raw and sut-attestation artifacts, runtime skill sources, and audit verdicts). Those paths and hashes were visible as part of the allowlisted file, but none of the referenced files were opened. Per-case audit verdicts present in the source were not used as evidence for any invariant judgement; all invariant results are based solely on the SUT-visible input and the raw output text.
